skills.name: casting-research-brief
skills.purpose: Generates an AI-summarised public-internet 'research brief' on a Mythie talent profile (press mentions, public social presence, sanctions/OFAC, public court-record references, identity-match sanity). Explicitly NOT a background check or consumer report under FCRA - the product copy directs casting teams to a regulated CRA for employment decisions. Tiered source matrix (A identity/sanctions, B press, C public-court-references, D social), hard-blocks Tier E (sex-offender registries, DMV, credit, criminal records, paid people-search aggregators). Locked legal banner, partner-CRA CTA, locked Claude summarisation prompt with banned-phrase validator, talent-side notification + opt-out, immutable audit log, 30-day TTL, per-tier rate limits. Legacy alternate names: 'Talent Insights', 'Pre-Casting Research'.
skills.when_to_use: any portfolio app that needs an AI-summarised public-internet research brief on a subject profile (reference impl: Mythie / CastHub1 as 'AI Talent Research'); trigger phrases 'run AI Talent Research on {name}', 'research this talent', 'generate a research brief', 'build a pre-casting brief'
skills.when_not_to_use: any flow that would inform an employment/housing/credit/insurance eligibility decision (route to partner-CRA instead); free / trial workspaces in any adopting app (route to upgrade flow); subjects who have opted out of research-permitted; minors (hard-blocked); apps that have not completed references/adoption-config.md; users without the configured {subject_kind}_research:read role
skills.revenue_impact: high - paid casting-team tier feature (gated to 'casting_pro' or above); gross margin protected by < $0.30/brief marginal-cost ceiling, plan-tier gate at the script + UI level, and shared NewsAPI vendor with seo-aeo-optimizer

skills.name: shipping-efficiency-budget

Pillar 2 — bundle related PRs via a 10-second pre-flight check + combine-or-split decision tree, with an end-of-session retro to catch fragmentation drift
skills.when_to_use: before opening any PR (Pillar 2 pre-flight check), quarterly portfolio audit of scheduled workflows (Pillar 1), about to push the 3rd small PR in a row to the same area, CI minutes trending up, user mentions saving Actions or loading PRs better
skills.when_not_to_use: user has explicitly asked for one-PR-per-change, hotfix that can't wait for a follow-up, change needs different review approval (legal vs feature)
skills.revenue_impact: direct cost reduction — GitHub Actions minutes are billed past free tier; secondary indirect impact via faster ship velocity (less reviewer queue thrashing)
skills.safety_impact: medium — over-fragmented PRs increase rebase / conflict surface; consolidated cron workflows have a wider blast radius if broken (mitigation guidance in the skill)

skills.name: tighten
skills.purpose: Plays a senior/principal-engineer reviewer leaning over the implementer's shoulder. Substantive design / correctness / cost / surface-area pass — not lint, not style. Pre-loaded question list across design, correctness, cost, blast-radius, failure-observability, naming, tests, and codebase-consistency axes. Forces a verdict (ship-as-is / tighten-then-ship / rework), every recommendation comes with explicit tradeoff, and every pass ends with a 'one non-obvious thing' observation that only a senior would catch. Includes a voice-rules section (no throat-clearing, no jerk mode, no style nits) and stack-conditional sharpening hooks
skills.when_to_use: after writing non-trivial code in-session (proactive), user says 'tighten' / 'could we have done that better' / 'double-check' / 'big boss review' / 'principal review', before merging an auto-drafted PR, after a `simplify` pass, any change touching money / identity / security / cross-cutting concerns
skills.when_not_to_use: trivial diffs (typo, dependency bump, one-line config), user is in flow asking for forward progress not review, /ultrareview already ran in the last hour, style/lint-only feedback (linter's job), user said 'ship as-is, don't second-guess'
skills.revenue_impact: indirect — catches design bugs before they become incidents, missing tests before they become regressions, premature abstractions before they become refactors
skills.safety_impact: high — explicit blast-radius + reversibility questions in the pre-baked list catch the security / money / data-loss class of issues that style review misses
